summary.text: Alexi Giannoulias is the Democratic Secretary of State of Illinois and won re-election on November 3, 2026, according to unofficial results.
A businessman and former state treasurer (2007–2011), he has announced a run for Chicago mayor in 2027.

paragraphs.text: Giannoulias lives in Chicago. He earned a bachelor's degree in economics from Boston University in 1998 and a law degree from Tulane University in 2002.
The Sun-Times reports that he played professional basketball in Greece and that he got his start in politics as a basketball-playing friend of Barack Obama.
Giannoulias founded and was CEO of Annoula Ventures, and he served as chairman of the Illinois Community College Board.
After leaving the treasurer's office in 2011, according to the City Club of Chicago, he became a senior director at BNY Mellon Wealth Management and taught at Northwestern University.
He was elected Illinois State Treasurer in 2006 and served from 2007 to 2011.
He was sworn in as the 38th Secretary of State on January 9, 2023, succeeding Jesse White, and won the Democratic primary for re-election on March 17, 2026.

In the office he has promoted online appointment scheduling for ID renewals and the deployment of kiosks at facilities; the Sun-Times also reports that he rolled back testing requirements for elderly drivers.
The Sun-Times describes him as a frontrunner in Chicago's 2027 mayoral election.
During the campaign, he emphasized continuing "momentum on modernization" of the office's services.
He won the November 3, 2026 general election for Secretary of State of Illinois with 64.8% of the vote to Diane Harris's 35.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: What to know about the Illinois secretary of state race between Alexi Giannoulias and Diane Harris
